reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because the speaker invites viewers to pay for BitClub Network mining participation while presenting prospective returns of 0.5–1 BTC, $25,000–$100,000, and an estimated 5–7 BTC from a $3,500 pack. Although the speaker describes the bitcoin-price figure as a prediction and encourages independent research, the presentation links paid participation to these large prospective returns.

citations.quote: There is one of 500 dollars that provides you with a share or participation of mining.
Every mining participation has a duration of thousand days.
another one of 2000$ that gives you 4 shares.
which like you and like me to buy mining machines and put in the company to work
Make your own numbers with a pack of 3500 dollars to mine.

opening.argument: Judge the figures as forecasts, not promises. The speaker calls the price estimate a prediction, asks viewers not to take his word for it, and directs them to reach their own conclusions. That framing matters when assessing whether the projected dollar values are being presented as assured returns.

citations.quote: I don't ask you to believe me when I talk this 3 years old price prediction.
I encourage you to search on Internet your own conclusions.
the most conservative predictions from all the experts talk about from 2020-2021 the price of Bitcoin will be between 50,000 and 100,000 dollars per unit

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited package prices and thousand-day duration establish what participation costs and how long it lasts; they do not establish that the dollar projections are guaranteed. The presentation expressly describes a key input to those projections as a prediction.

citations.quote: Every mining participation has a duration of thousand days.
I don't ask you to believe me when I talk this 3 years old price prediction.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling the Bitcoin price a prediction does not make the mining-output pitch merely market commentary. The speaker separately tells viewers that buying a mining share would yield substantial Bitcoin and attaches large dollar figures to that purchase. An invitation to research the price forecast does not qualify those claims about paid participation.

citations.quote: On the other hand, having bought mining participation, you will have between half and one Bitcoin.
share, you'd have between 25.000 and 100.000 dollars, making extra 500,000 dollars.

opening.argument: Much of the presentation walks through how Bitcoin and mining work, then shows viewers where the speaker is looking: blockchain records and a venture-capital page. That gives the judge a reason to read the purchase comparison as part of an explanatory demonstration, not as the whole purpose of the video.

citations.quote: But first, i want to explain you about bitcoin and the concept of bitcoin mining.
Right now we are in blockchain .inf, the website where absolutely all Bitcoin movements and transactions are made all around the world
Right now we are at coindesk.com. I invite you to enter here and go to the chapter titled Venture Capital which you will find here.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening isolates the paid packages and projected returns, but it omits the speaker's stated intent to explain Bitcoin mining and his walkthrough of outside pages. Those passages support reading the figures as an illustrated comparison within a broader lesson, even though the comparison favors participation.

citations.quote: But first, i want to explain you about bitcoin and the concept of bitcoin mining.
And now I am going to show you the difference that it would represent, buy Bitcoins in itself, directly, in front of buying mining participation in BitClub Network.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The explanation supplies context for the offer, but the speaker moves from it to purchasable shares and tells nonmembers they can start benefiting today. Showing blockchain or market pages does not verify the projected returns from a viewer's purchase.

citations.quote: There is one of 500 dollars that provides you with a share or participation of mining.
If you have not been part of BitClub Network up to now, you have not yet be able to enjoy the benefits distributed between you and me But today you can start it

opening.argument: What is concretely described is a priced mining service: packages buy different numbers of participations, with a stated term and a separate license cost. The cited material does not show a credential request or explain a recruitment-payment chain. The stronger reading is a commercial offer whose performance claims need scrutiny, not proof from this record alone that the transaction has an undisclosed scam mechanism.

citations.quote: There is one of 500 dollars that provides you with a share or participation of mining. One of 1000 dollars that provides you with two. another one of 2000$ that gives you 4 shares.
the only extra cost is 99$ of license paid once in a lifetime. Every mining participation has a duration of thousand days.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's quotes establish a payment, a term and a projected benefit. Payment for a service, even one promoted with ambitious estimates, does not by itself establish that the described mining participation is fictitious. The speaker identifies what the buyer is ostensibly purchasing rather than asking for an unexplained transfer.

citations.quote: There is one of 500 dollars that provides you with a share or participation of mining.
Every mining participation has a duration of thousand days.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: An identified price and term do not resolve the concern. They are the way viewers are asked to enter the paid mining arrangement, which the speaker links to ongoing benefits and striking projected returns. The concern does not depend on finding a credential request or a recruitment chain.

On the other hand, having bought mining participation, you will have between half and one Bitcoin.
